metadata.description: Unblock plan for screens blocked by missing foundations

summary.description: All screens are unblocked once Wave 0 foundations are migrated. No screens have circular dependencies or missing foundations that would prevent migration.

wave0_unblock_tasks.description: Minimal foundational work required to unblock all screens

tasks.name: Migrate colorHelper constant
tasks.description: Convert colorHelper constant to Angular InjectionToken or utility service. Required by baConfig.
tasks.implementation_notes: Pure functions for tint/shade color manipulation. No external dependencies.

tasks.name: Migrate layoutSizes constant
tasks.description: Convert layoutSizes constant to Angular InjectionToken. Required by baSidebarService.
tasks.implementation_notes: Simple object with responsive breakpoint values. Consider using Angular CDK BreakpointObserver as alternative.

tasks.name: Migrate layoutPaths constant
tasks.description: Convert layoutPaths constant to Angular InjectionToken with environment configuration.
tasks.implementation_notes: Asset path configuration. Consider using Angular's asset handling and environment files.

tasks.name: Migrate baConfig provider
tasks.description: Convert baConfig provider to Angular injectable service. Central theme configuration.
tasks.implementation_notes: Provider pattern needs conversion to service with InjectionToken for configuration. Consider APP_INITIALIZER for theme setup.

tasks.name: Migrate baUtil service
tasks.description: Convert baUtil service to Angular service. Utility functions for DOM and colors.
tasks.implementation_notes: Replace jQuery-dependent methods with native DOM or Angular Renderer2. hexToRGB function is pure.

tasks.name: Migrate baSidebarService provider
tasks.description: Convert baSidebarService provider to Angular service with reactive state.
tasks.implementation_notes: Use BehaviorSubject for menu state. Integrate with Angular Router for dynamic menu generation from route config.

tasks.name: Migrate baSidebar directive
tasks.description: Convert baSidebar directive to Angular component. Main navigation component.
tasks.implementation_notes: Complex directive with controller. Convert to standalone component. Handle responsive behavior with BreakpointObserver.

tasks.name: Migrate baPanel directive
tasks.description: Convert baPanel directive to Angular component. Used by ALL screens.
tasks.implementation_notes: Panel container with blur effect support. Convert to component with content projection.
